_about: Podcast Punch 9 (v9) (trained 5 Oct 2026 from 20 Top-100 refs; anchor r31 drive client edit (score 8); ~/reels/style-train/podcast-punch). A podcast / talking-head clip cut into a punchy short: colour speaker with a moody cinematic grade, stacked word-cluster captions (small bold white lead words, ONE bigger yellow key word), colour film b-roll as full-bleed cutaways AND as floating rounded cards on black with the caption still running, hard cuts, restrained sound. Variants change the accent, caption scale/case and how heavy the b-roll is. Score 70.0 vs the 9 clean refs under measure v2 (punch-ins counted; v7 re-scored 67.9). v9 adds one `ground` beat (cut-out speaker on a black page, a big yellow spoken number behind him; reel needs matte: true).

director.style: Podcast Punch: a podcast or talking-head clip cut into a punchy short. The speaker stays in COLOUR with a moody film grade; the words do the punching (small white lead words, one bigger yellow key word per line); colour film b-roll illustrates the line, either full-bleed or as a floating rounded card on black.
director.captions: captions.heroes: one key word per spoken line (the noun or verb that carries it, never filler like 'really', 'so', 'cause'); lines without a key word stay all small. Lowercase, 2-4 words per caption, stacked under the chin. captions.script: at most 1 word per 20 s in the yellow script (the emotional or brand word).
director.cutaways: ~3 b-roll beats per 20 s (v6: 3 measured closest, 24 changes/min; 4 ran busy at 30/min), 0.8-1.6 s each, captions: true, LITERAL-ish colour film footage of what is said (campus for 'university', servers for 'workflows'). Alternate kind 'image' (full-bleed, grade podcastPunch.cutawayGrade) and kind 'window' (floating rounded card on black, grade podcastPunch.cardGrade). Stills from stock_fetch.py (public domain / CC0), or { self: <source s> } for the speaker's own footage in a window. Once per reel, on a numbered point ('number one'), a `ground` beat (color #0b0b0b, text = the spoken number word, textColor the accent, textSize ~420, ~1.2 s; needs reel "matte": true): the cut-out speaker on black with the word behind him (refs #31, #78).
director.rhythm: Picture changes every ~1.5-2.5 s (punch-ins every ~2.6 s on the speaker plus cutaways). Hard cuts only. Return to the speaker for at least 1 s between two cutaways. Hook: first change inside 1.5 s.
director.dont: No podcast_plan.py boxes, Like button or show logo (that is the Diary-of-a-CEO preset, not this family). No black word cards (that is Monochrome Cinema).
